title: CertiSum: Bitwise-Identical MXFP4 Training Across Platforms and Parallelism Layouts
abstract: arXiv:2611.21584v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Training with MXFP4, a 4-bit microscaling format, is non-deterministic: identical inputs can produce different results across parallelism layouts and GPU vendors. These differences complicate debugging and training audits and can cause training and inference engines to disagree. We present CertiSum to make MXFP4 training bitwise invariant across runs, parallelism layouts, and GPU vendors. Its key insight is that native FP32 accumulation of MXFP4 products is often already exact for every summation order. CertiSum collects statistics during quantization to certify native matrix multiplication results, recomputes uncertified outputs exactly, and uses exact kernels directly where certification rarely succeeds. CertiSum keeps quantization blocks unchanged across layouts and merges partial sums without rounding, including in attention and weight-gradient computation. In 200-step Qwen3-8B-Base experiments, CertiSum preserves training states bit

translated_title: CertiSum：跨平台与并行布局实现逐位一致的MXFP4训练
translated_abstract: 使用MXFP4（一种4位微缩放格式）进行训练是非确定性的：相同的输入在不同的并行布局和GPU厂商之间可能产生不同的结果。这些差异使调试和训练审计变得复杂，并可能导致训练引擎与推理引擎之间产生分歧。我们提出CertiSum，使MXFP4训练在多次运行、并行布局和GPU厂商之间实现逐位不变性。其关键洞察是：MXFP4乘积的原生FP32累加对于各种求和顺序而言往往已经是精确的。CertiSum在量化过程中收集统计数据以认证原生矩阵乘法结果的精确性，对未通过认证的输出进行精确重算，并在认证很少成功的情况下直接使用精确内核。CertiSum在不同布局间保持量化块不变，且在合并部分和时不进行舍入，包括在注意力计算和权重梯度计算中。在200步的Qwen3-8B-Base实验中，CertiSum逐位保留训练状态。
tldr: CertiSum利用MXFP4乘积的FP32累加通常本身即精确这一洞察，通过认证原生矩阵乘法结果并精确重算未认证输出，实现了MXFP4训练在不同运行、并行布局和GPU厂商之间的逐位一致性。
en_tdlr: CertiSum achieves bitwise-invariant MXFP4 training across runs, parallelism layouts, and GPU vendors by certifying that native FP32 accumulation of MXFP4 products is already exact and recomputing only uncertified outputs precisely.
